references.text: The continuation of the account where the earth opens up and swallows Korah and his followers, directly following the event in verse 31.
A flashback to Korah's rebellion where the earth opened up and swallowed them, confirming the historical event.
Moses reminds the people what the earth did with Dathan and Abiram when it opened beneath them.
The psalm describes how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered over Abiram's group, a poetic retelling of the event.
Isaiah uses similar imagery about Sheol opening its mouth, which can be linked to the earth opening as judgment.
The earth opens its mouth to receive Abel's blood, an early example of the earth actively participating in God's judgment.
